title: Gateless Barrier, Case 14: Nan-ch'uan Kills the Cat
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk's main teaching is that true understanding and peace come from embracing life as it is, without trying to control or predict its twists and turns. By letting go of our attachments to plans and expectations, we can tap into the present moment and find genuine connection and compassion with ourselves and others. This approach encourages us to be open, humble, and aware, allowing us to navigate life's challenges with greater ease and wisdom.
